title: Defence #1 · Army ranks: which rank wears this? (Brigadier), then Lieutenant to General and the Field Marshal

captions.instagram:
Which rank wears this? A Colonel, B Brigadier or C Major Gen?
Which rank will you retire as? Comment 👇

Answer: B, Brigadier: the national emblem + 3 stars in a triangle. A Colonel has only 2.

Indian Army officer ranks, Lieutenant to General:
Lieutenant · Captain · Major · Lt Colonel · Colonel · Brigadier · Major General · Lt General · General

Every NDA cadet is commissioned as a Lieutenant after IMA.
Field Marshal: only 2 ever held it, Manekshaw (1973) and Cariappa (1986).

Save this for your SSB prep.
